run_codegen_main: run the functorch codegen script to generate vmap plumbing C++ headers
run_generate_code: run generate_code to produce VmapGeneratedPlumbing.h in the specified install directory
run_codegen_with_source_path: run the codegen script with a custom ATen source path via the -s flag
run_codegen_with_install_dir: run the codegen script with a custom output directory via the -d flag
review_generate_code: review the generate_code function that parses native_functions.yaml and writes vmap plumbing headers
